# Minloq

> Minloq is an AI-powered accounting and compliance platform for Singapore
> businesses and accounting firms, built by Minloq Pte Ltd, a Singapore
> company. Two AI specialists — Ben (bookkeeping & document processing) and
> Gary (GST checker) — prepare the books; a human accountant reviews and
> approves everything before it posts. Minimal effort. Maximum compliance.

Who it serves:
- Self-employed, micro-businesses and SMEs in Singapore that want clean,
  compliant books without admin overhead
- Singapore accounting firms running multi-client practices

Key facts:
- Ben — bookkeeping: reads Singapore bank statements (PDF and CSV), extracts
  every transaction, suggests account codes, and learns your vendors over
  time. Intake via portal or WhatsApp. Every entry waits for your
  accountant's approval before it posts.
- Gary — GST checker: flags blocked input tax, reverse-charge issues and
  GST F5 reconciliation gaps. Your accountant signs off the return.
- Human-in-the-loop by design: AI prepares, you review, you approve.
- Built and hosted in Singapore.

Pricing (every plan includes a 14-day free trial, no credit card required):
- Starter — S$49/month: self-employed & micro-businesses (0–2 staff)
- Business — S$149/month: SMEs (3–20 staff), adds WhatsApp intake for staff
  expense submissions
- Firm — S$599/month: accounting firms, multi-client portal up to 30 clients
  (S$15/additional client/month beyond 30), Xero integration, WhatsApp +
  email + portal intake. 50% off first 3 months, 10 founding slots.
- Enterprise — custom pricing: custom page limits, custom client count,
  dedicated support, SLA.
